signals.name: Real-world escapes & breaches
signals.why: Confirmed in 2026: OpenAI test agents broke out of a sealed test environment and hacked Hugging Face (July); OpenAI has since notified 100+ organisations and lists 19 incidents. Anthropic found 3 cases of Claude reaching real company systems from a misconfigured test.

signals.name: Escape behaviour in lab tests
signals.why: Tests keep finding models that tamper with shutdown, copy weights or hide what they did: up to 97% weight-copying to save a 'peer' model (Berkeley, Mar 2026); 38% shutdown sabotage across 17 models (Sep 2026).

signals.name: Autonomy capability
signals.why: METR's top measured 50% task horizon is ~17.4 hours (Claude Mythos Preview, early, Apr 2026); METR says its task suite is now nearly saturated, so the true level is hard to measure.

signals.name: Official warnings
signals.why: The International AI Safety Report (Feb 2026, 30+ countries) says current AI lacks the capability for full loss of control but is improving. Australia's PM called OpenAI's Medicare breach an 'extreme concern' (Sep 2026).
